title: From Risk Prediction to Risk Mechanisms: A Multi-Resolution Causal Representation for Road Safety and Motor Insurance
abstract: arXiv:2608.09441v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Operational risk models can estimate event frequencies precisely while leaving the underlying mechanisms weakly resolved. We study this resolution mismatch using motor insurance and road safety. A revisable DAG represents trip-level crash generation; a separate predictive layer links annual rating information to latent driving states; and an observation process maps crashes into recorded liability claims. Compatibility sets collect the structural and crash-to-claim laws that reproduce an observed annual contrast under stated restrictions. External studies enter only through explicit bridge assumptions and sensitivity bounds. The framework therefore distinguishes sampling uncertainty from uncertainty about structure, observation, and study-to-target correspondence. Two limited examples illustrate the gap. A sublinear mileage relation constrains an aggregate accident rate per unit distance but not its mechanism. In French motor-l

translated_title: 从风险预测到风险机制：面向道路安全与汽车保险的多分辨率因果表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.09441v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：操作风险模型能够精确估计事件频率，但对潜在机制的解析却很薄弱。我们以汽车保险和道路安全为例研究这种分辨率不匹配问题。一个可修订的有向无环图（DAG）表示行程级碰撞生成过程；一个独立的预测层将年度评级信息与潜在驾驶状态联系起来；一个观测过程将碰撞映射为记录的赔偿责任索赔。兼容性集合收集在给定限制条件下再现观测到的年度对比的结构性和碰撞到索赔法则。外部研究仅通过明确的桥接假设和敏感性界限进入。因此，该框架区分了抽样不确定性与结构、观测以及研究到目标对应关系的不确定性。两个有限示例说明了这一差距。一个次线性里程关系约束了每单位距离的聚合事故率，但未约束其机制。在法国机动车保险中...
tldr: 本文提出一种多分辨率因果框架，通过区分风险预测中的抽样不确定性与机制不确定性，揭示操作风险模型在精度与机制解析间的差距，并以道路安全和汽车保险为例加以说明。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-resolution causal framework that distinguishes sampling uncertainty from mechanism uncertainty in risk prediction, revealing the gap between predictive precision and mechanistic resolution, illustrated with road safety and motor insurance.
